Initial release of cn-timestamp-tool – 时间戳转换工具

- Converts between Unix timestamps and human-readable date/time
- Supports both directions: timestamp ↔ date/time
- Fetches current timestamp in seconds or milliseconds
- Includes timezone support, defaulting to Asia/Shanghai
- Built with standard Python libraries, no external dependencies
